outcome: Frequency of labor augmentation with oxytocin
cohort: 4350 women who gave birth between 2015 and 2020 at a single center in Warsaw, Poland
finding: BMI, preinduction, epidural anesthesia, and family presence at birth were associated with increased frequency of labor stimulation with oxytocin, while previous pregnancies, cesarean sections, and pre-pregnancy hypertension were associated with reduced frequency.
